page.layout: One page of text, single column; a heading block (Dissertatio XXXIII. with title) mid-page; a small-type note block "Notæ in Chronicon Sarracenicum" with a dropped-capital entry below the heading; no margin notes; page number at head.

main_text.l: est. Simul cum in verba ejus omnes pro
more jurassent, corona capiti impositá est;
quod id Acamapixtli significat, data sunt.
Hæc novi Regis electio tam feliciter
successit, ut brevi tempore urbs magno
tur. Quare vicini invidia, metu, ut solet,
excitati; cum viderent hos advenas brevi

page.notes: The dropped capitals N are woodcut initials; the entry at 597 is partly set in italic. Last line "CCC" is a number set at the right. The text "Ihil hic fani" is read as printed; the Latin "Nihil" with its initial is uncertain. Right-margin and marks are not notes.
